"""Verify the inactive native RBX::Adorn interface, RBX::AdornG3D and RBX::AdornRbxGfx (2008-06).

Builds (document-swap flags plus the Ogre 1.4.5 client headers, VS2008 RTM 21022, /fp:fast), all from the current native
headers (native-headers/RbxGraphics/Adorn2008.h, AppDraw/AdornG3D2008.h, RbxGraphics/AdornRbxGfx2008.h and the
committed RbxGraphics/TextureProxyBase2008.h / RenderLib/TextureProxy2008.h; non-colliding names, so no donor header is
shadowed for any other unit):
  * tests/NativeAdornLayout.cpp        sizeof/offset probes (mov eax, imm32; ret) and nativeNewAdornG3D, which
                                       instantiates the header-inline constructor so that the object carries the
                                       AdornG3D vtable, ??_G and G3D::Table<TextureArgs, TextureRef>::freeMemory;
  * native-classes/AdornG3D.cpp        AdornG3D method bodies 00676480..00676aff;
  * tests/NativeAdornRbxGfxLayout.cpp  AdornRbxGfx sizeof/offset probes;
  * native-classes/AdornRbxGfx.cpp     AdornRbxGfx bodies that need only its own layout, and the container COMDATs of
                                       its image block (0066fc30..00671d5f).

A second, pending-only build of AdornRbxGfx.cpp (/DNATIVE_ADORNRBXGFX_PENDING plus a generated copy of
RenderLib/TextureProxy2008.h with the proposed RenderNew::TextureProxy(const std::string&) constructor, under
out/native-layouts/adornrbxgfx-pending/, ahead of native-headers for that build only) compiles createTextureProxy. Its
row is recorded exact=false (pending-build-only) and is not counted; vtable checks use current-header objects only.

Every exact row is relocation-masked exact against the original, and every REL32/DIR32 target is bound to the address
the original instruction uses and verified: imports by DLL export name, constants by bytes, vtables by original RTTI
names, own symbols by the row proven here, folded bodies by their bytes, data by address, and the remaining externals
by the explicit EXTERNAL map (call sites read in the original disassembly, structure checked below). One address per
symbol. Rows folded by the linker onto bodies outside the class block are compared and recorded, not counted.
Writes work/2008-06/shared-layouts/adorn-working.json. Set NATIVE_ADORN_DISCOVER=1 to list unbound targets and
non-exact rows instead of asserting.

        ['/Fo' + str(obj), str(src)]
    code, log = rebuild.run(rebuild.toolchain(21022), 'cl', flags, OUT)

    return obj, flags

def verify(obj, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in FOLDED:
                assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'folded'
            elif symbol in DATA:
                assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'data'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):

        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:

def target_of(address):
    if isinstance(address, tuple) and address[0] == 'slice':
        _, row, lo, hi = address
        body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % row)
        assert len(body) >= hi, (hex(row), len(body), hi)
        return body[lo:hi], [r - lo for r in refs if lo <= r < hi]
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return body, refs


def first(address):
    if isinstance(address, tuple) and address[0] == 'slice':
        return address[1] + address[2]
    return address


def label(address):
    if isinstance(address, tuple) and address[0] == 'slice':
        return '%08x[%02x:%02x]' % address[1:]
    return '%08x' % address


def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', label(address), key[:120], [h[0][:120] for h in hits])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, (label(address), key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def verify(obj, rows, own, strict=True, external=EXTERNAL, data=DATA, record=True):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': label(address), 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        base = first(address)
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (base + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
                assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own row (??_G)'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in FOLDED:
                assert FOLDED['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'folded (??_G)'
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in FOLDED:
                assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'folded'
            elif symbol in data:
                assert data[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'data'
            elif symbol in external:
                assert external[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(external[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
            elif symbol in UNPROVEN:
                assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'call target of a non-exact row'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('??_B?3??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?flag@') \
                    or symbol.startswith('?foo@') or symbol.startswith('?n@') or symbol.startswith('?root@') \
                    or symbol.startswith('?minSize@'):
                how = 'local static'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address, reference=None, own_class=''):
    """Each slot holds the address bound to its symbol, the evidence name, or (for an inherited slot) the same
    address as the base class's vtable at `reference`."""
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            expect, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]], 'bound (??_G)'
        else:
            expect, how = slot_names.get(slot), 'bound'
        ok = expect == value if expect is not None else norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(slot)
        if expect is None:
            how = 'evidence name'
        if not ok and reference is not None:
            cls = slot.split('@')[1] if slot.startswith('?') and not slot.startswith('??') else ''
            if cls != own_class and value == d(reference + 4 * i):
                ok, how = True, 'inherited (same slot of the base vtable %08x)' % reference
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value)))
    assert not bad, (symbol, bad)
    return out

def bases(vtable):
    hierarchy = d(d(vtable - 4) + 16)
    out = {}
    for i in range(d(hierarchy + 8)):

        out.setdefault(original.string(d(bcd) + 8), struct.unpack('<i', original.data(bcd + 8, 4))[0])
    return out

rebuild/2008-06/tests/record_native_hit_.text:
"""Verify the inactive native hit-test filters (2008-06): RBX::Unlocked, RBX::PartByLocalCharacter,
RBX::UnlockedPartByLocalCharacter, RBX::FilterStairs, RBX::FilterCharacterOcclusion (HitTestFilter interface from the
donor util/HitTestFilter.h).

Builds (document-swap flags, VS2008 RTM 21022, /fp:fast for both: the unit's getIsTransparent 006601c0 and the
FilterCharacterOcclusion compare 00660220 are fp:fast code), all from the current native headers:
  * tests/NativeHitTestFilterLayout.cpp   sizeof probes (mov eax, imm32; ret), offset asserts, and the inline
                                          constructors that emit Unlocked::filterResult 00615b60, the implicit
                                          ~PartByLocalCharacter 00615b80 (both MouseCommand-unit COMDATs in the
                                          original) and the Unlocked / UnlockedPartByLocalCharacter vtables;
  * native-classes/Filters.cpp            the unit 006601c0..00660544;
  * Filters.cpp with NATIVE_HIT_FILTERS_PENDING and the declaration-only Humanoid overlay
    (tests/NativeHitTestFilterPendingHumanoid.h copied to out/native-layouts/hit-filters-pending/humanoid/Humanoid.h):
    the PartByLocalCharacter constructor 00660380. Rows of this build are recorded exact=false (pending-build-only)
    and not counted; their targets are kept out of the one-address-per-symbol table.

Every exact row is relocation-masked exact against the original, and every REL32/DIR32 target is bound to the address
the original instruction uses and verified: imports by DLL export name, literals by bytes, RTTI and vtables by
original RTTI names, own symbols by the row proven here, and the remaining externals by the EXTERNAL map (evidence
names, or the call-site / registration evidence noted there). Vtables are compared slot by slot from the objects built
with the current headers (never the pending one). Writes work/2008-06/shared-layouts/hit-filters-working.json.
Set NATIVE_HIT_FILTERS_DISCOVER=1 to list unbound targets and non-exact rows instead of asserting.
"""
import json
import os
import shutil
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from roc import match, rebuild  # noqa: E402
import native_bind as nb  # noqa: E402

R = ROOT / 'rebuild/2008-06'
OUT = nb.OUT
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
LAYOUT = R / 'tests/NativeHitTestFilterLayout.cpp'
SRC = R / 'native-classes/Filters.cpp'
HDR = R / 'native-headers/v8datamodel/Filters2008.h'
PENDING_HUMANOID = R / 'tests/NativeHitTestFilterPendingHumanoid.h'
PENDING = OUT / 'hit-filters-pending'
(PENDING / 'humanoid').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(PENDING_HUMANOID, PENDING / 'humanoid/Humanoid.h')
DISCOVER = bool(os.environ.get('NATIVE_HIT_FILTERS_DISCOVER'))


def build(name, src, extra=()):
    obj = OUT / (name + '.obj')
    flags = nb.flags()
    i = next(k for k, x in enumerate(flags) if x.replace('\\', '/').endswith('rebuild/2008-06/native-headers'))
    flags = flags[:i] + list(extra) + flags[i:] + ['/Fo' + str(obj), str(src)]
    code, log = rebuild.run(rebuild.toolchain(21022), 'cl', flags, OUT)
    assert code == 0, log
    return obj, flags


layout_obj, layout_flags = build('NativeHitTestFilterLayout', LAYOUT, ['/fp:fast'])
unit_obj, unit_flags = build('NativeHitTestFilters', SRC, ['/fp:fast'])
pend_obj, pend_flags = build('NativeHitTestFiltersPending', SRC,
                             ['/fp:fast', '/I' + str(PENDING), '/DNATIVE_HIT_FILTERS_PENDING'])

# ---- layout ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
raw = layout_obj.read_bytes()
SIZES = {'nativePartByLocalCharacterSize': 0x14, 'nativeUnlockedPartByLocalCharacterSize': 0x14,
         'nativeFilterStairsSize': 0x0c, 'nativeUnlockedSize': 4, 'nativeFilterCharacterOcclusionSize': 4}
for fn, size in SIZES.items():
    name_, body_, _ = next(x for x in match.coff_functions(raw) if x[0].startswith('?' + fn + '@@'))
    assert body_ == b'\xb8' + struct.pack('<I', size) + b'\xc3', (fn, body_.hex())

original = nb.Original()
names = {int(k, 16): v.get('symbol', '') for k, v in json.loads((R / 'offline/evidence.json').read_text())['names'].items()}
d = lambda a: struct.unpack('<I', original.data(a, 4))[0]

# PartInstance::getCanCollide 00598d20 has no evidence name: the "CanCollide" property registration 007f4870 passes
# it as the getter (mov edi, 00598d20 at 007f4891) next to the setter 0059dd80 (007f487b) and the name 00833180.
assert original.data(0x7f4891, 5) == b'\xbf' + struct.pack('<I', 0x598d20)
assert original.data(0x7f487b, 5) == b'\xb9' + struct.pack('<I', 0x59dd80)
assert original.data(0x7f48a4, 5) == b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', 0x833180)
assert original.string(0x833180) == 'CanCollide'

EXTERNAL = {
    '?fromPrimitiveConst@PartInstance@RBX@@SAPBV12@PBVPrimitive@2@@Z': 0x599f80,   # 006601f5, 00660226, 0066032f
    '?isDescendentOf@Instance@RBX@@QBE_NPBV12@@Z': 0x422ae0,                        # 0066034b
    '?getCanCollide@PartInstance@RBX@@QBE_NXZ': 0x598d20,                           # 00660232, 00660356 (see above)
    '??$shared_from@VInstance@RBX@@@RBX@@YA?AV?$shared_ptr@VInstance@RBX@@@boost@@PAVInstance@0@@Z': 0x618a40,  # 006604dd
    '??4shared_count@detail@boost@@QAEAAV012@ABV012@@Z': 0x4025b0,                  # 006604f6
    '__purecall': 0x6a16be,                                                         # HitTestFilter vtable 00843a40 slot 0
    '??0PartByLocalCharacter@RBX@@QAE@PAVInstance@1@@Z': 0x660380,                  # MouseCommand 00616023 (pending row)
}
PENDING_EXTERNAL = {
    '?findLocalCharacter@Players@Network@RBX@@SAPAVModelInstance@3@PBVInstance@3@@Z': 0x49aca0,      # 006603c3
    '?getHeadFromCharacter@Humanoid@RBX@@SAPAVPartInstance@2@PBVModelInstance@2@@Z': 0x5d75a0,         # 00660429
    # ICF: shared_from<ModelInstance> / <PartInstance> fold into the shared_from<Instance> body (006603ce, 00660434).
    '??$shared_from@VModelInstance@RBX@@@RBX@@YA?AV?$shared_ptr@VModelInstance@RBX@@@boost@@PAVModelInstance@0@@Z': 0x618a40,
    '??$shared_from@VPartInstance@RBX@@@RBX@@YA?AV?$shared_ptr@VPartInstance@RBX@@@boost@@PAVPartInstance@0@@Z': 0x618a40,
}

LAYOUT_ROWS = [
    (0x615b60, '?filterResult@Unlocked@RBX@@UBE?AW4Result@HitTestFilter@2@PBVPrimitive@2@@Z'),
    (0x615b80, '??1PartByLocalCharacter@RBX@@QAE@XZ'),
]
UNIT_ROWS = [
    (0x6601f0, '?unlocked@Unlocked@RBX@@SA_NPBVPrimitive@2@@Z'),
    (0x660210, '??0FilterCharacterOcclusion@RBX@@QAE@H@Z'),
    (0x660220, '?filterResult@FilterCharacterOcclusion@RBX@@UBE?AW4Result@HitTestFilter@2@PBVPrimitive@2@@Z'),
    (0x660320, '?filterResult@FilterStairs@RBX@@UBE?AW4Result@HitTestFilter@2@PBVPrimitive@2@@Z'),
    (0x6604a0, '??0FilterStairs@RBX@@QAE@PAVInstance@1@@Z'),
]
NON_EXACT_ROWS = [
    (0x6601c0, '?getIsTransparent@PartInstance@RBX@@QBE_NXZ',
     'inline PartInstance member from native v8datamodel/PartInstance.h (other owner): the 2008 body is '
     '1 - (1 - transparency) * alphaModifier > 0.1f with alphaModifier at +0x328 (Primitive embedded at +0x228); the '
     'header gives (1 - transparency) * alphaModifier > 0.1f with alphaModifier at +0x230 (proposal)'),
    (0x660260, '?filterResult@PartByLocalCharacter@RBX@@UBE?AW4Result@HitTestFilter@2@PBVPrimitive@2@@Z',
     'the original calls getIsTransparent 006601c0 out of line; this /fp:fast build inlines the in-class definition '
     '(115 vs 73 bytes). Built without /fp:fast the call stays out of line and only edx/ecx differ, but then '
     'FilterCharacterOcclusion 00660220 and the 006601c0 body need /fp:fast. Cause not identified'),
    (0x6602b0, '?filterResult@UnlockedPartByLocalCharacter@RBX@@UBE?AW4Result@HitTestFilter@2@PBVPrimitive@2@@Z',
     'inlines PartByLocalCharacter::filterResult in the original; here the inlined getIsTransparent makes it too large '
     'to inline (same cause as 00660260)'),
]
PENDING_ROWS = [
    (0x660380, '??0PartByLocalCharacter@RBX@@QAE@PAVInstance@1@@Z'),
]
PENDING_REASONS = {
    '00660380': 'needs a Humanoid::getHeadFromCharacter(const ModelInstance*) declaration (005d75a0): no native '
                'humanoid/Humanoid.h; built against the declaration-only overlay tests/NativeHitTestFilterPendingHumanoid.h',
}

LOCAL_EH = nb.LOCAL_EH
UNBOUND = []
binding = {}


def norm(symbol):
    return symbol.replace('3QBDB', '3PBDB').replace('3PADA', '3PBDB')


def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', '%08x' % address, key[:120], [h[0][:120] for h in hits])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def verify(obj, rows, own, strict=True, external=EXTERNAL, record=True):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in external:
                assert external[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(external[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result


layout_rows = resolve(layout_obj, LAYOUT_ROWS)
unit_rows = resolve(unit_obj, UNIT_ROWS)
pend_rows = resolve(pend_obj, PENDING_ROWS)
non_rows = resolve(unit_obj, [(a, k) for a, k, _ in NON_EXACT_ROWS])
own = {}
for address, name in layout_rows + unit_rows:
    own.setdefault(name, address)
strict = not DISCOVER
layout_out = verify(layout_obj, layout_rows, own, strict)
unit_out = verify(unit_obj, unit_rows, own, strict)
pend_out = verify(pend_obj, pend_rows, own, strict=False, external=dict(EXTERNAL, **PENDING_EXTERNAL), record=False)
for row in pend_out:
    row['exact_pending_build_only'] = row['exact']
    row['exact'] = False
    row['reason'] = PENDING_REASONS[row['address']]
non_out = verify(unit_obj, non_rows, own, strict=False)
for row, (_, _, why) in zip(non_out, NON_EXACT_ROWS):
    if row['exact'] and not DISCOVER:
        raise AssertionError('non-exact row unexpectedly exact: %s' % row['address'])
    row['exact'], row['reason'] = False, why
if DISCOVER:
    print('\n'.join(sorted(set(UNBOUND))))
    for r in pend_out:
        print('PENDING', r['address'], r['exact_pending_build_only'], r['symbol'][:100], r['size'], r['target_size'])
    for g in (layout_out, unit_out):
        for r in g:
            if not r['exact']:
                print('NOT EXACT', r['address'], r['symbol'][:110], r['size'], r['target_size'])
    sys.exit(0)
assert not UNBOUND, '\n'.join(UNBOUND)
assert all(r['exact_pending_build_only'] for r in pend_out), pend_out

# ---- vtables from the objects built with the current headers, slot by slot ---------------------------------
slot_names = dict(EXTERNAL)
slot_names.update(own)
# PartByLocalCharacter::filterResult and UnlockedPartByLocalCharacter::filterResult are non-exact rows: their slots are
# checked by address only (the original slot holds the row address; the body is not claimed).
UNPROVEN_SLOTS = {r[1]: r[0] for r in non_rows}


def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address):
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot in slot_names:
            expect, how = slot_names[slot], 'bound'
        elif slot in UNPROVEN_SLOTS:
            expect, how = UNPROVEN_SLOTS[slot], 'address of a non-exact row'
        else:
            expect, how = None, 'evidence name'
        ok = expect == value if expect is not None else norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(slot)
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value)))
    assert not bad, (symbol, bad)
    return out


def bases(vtable):
    hierarchy = d(d(vtable - 4) + 16)
    out = {}
    for i in range(d(hierarchy + 8)):
        bcd = d(d(hierarchy + 12) + 4 * i)
        out.setdefault(original.string(d(bcd) + 8), struct.unpack('<i', original.data(bcd + 8, 4))[0])
    return out


VTABLES = [
    (layout_obj, 'HitTestFilter', 0x843a40, ['HitTestFilter']),
    (layout_obj, 'Unlocked', 0x843a48, ['Unlocked', 'HitTestFilter']),
    (layout_obj, 'UnlockedPartByLocalCharacter', 0x843a50, ['UnlockedPartByLocalCharacter', 'PartByLocalCharacter', 'HitTestFilter']),
    (unit_obj, 'FilterCharacterOcclusion', 0x84c45c, ['FilterCharacterOcclusion', 'HitTestFilter']),
    (unit_obj, 'FilterStairs', 0x84c46c, ['FilterStairs', 'HitTestFilter']),
]
vt, rtti = {}, {}
for obj, cls, address, chain in VTABLES:
    assert original.vtable_class(address) == ('.?AV%s@RBX@@' % cls, 0), (cls, original.vtable_class(address))
    vt[cls] = check_vtable(obj, '??_7%s@RBX@@6B@' % cls, address)
    assert len(vt[cls]) == 1, (cls, vt[cls])
    b = bases(address)
    assert b == {'.?AV%s@RBX@@' % c: 0 for c in chain}, (cls, b)
    rtti[cls] = b
# PartByLocalCharacter's vtable is only emitted by the pending build (its constructor is the pending row); the original
# table is checked by RTTI and its one slot (the 00660260 row address), the compiled one is not claimed.
assert original.vtable_class(0x84c464) == ('.?AVPartByLocalCharacter@RBX@@', 0)
assert d(0x84c464) == 0x660260 and d(0x84c464 + 4) != 0x660260
rtti['PartByLocalCharacter'] = bases(0x84c464)
assert rtti['PartByLocalCharacter'] == {'.?AVPartByLocalCharacter@RBX@@': 0, '.?AVHitTestFilter@RBX@@': 0}

sha = nb.sha
paths = [Path(__file__).resolve(), LAYOUT, HDR, SRC, PENDING_HUMANOID]
objects = [layout_obj, unit_obj, pend_obj]
groups = {'layout': layout_out, 'unit': unit_out, 'not_exact': non_out, 'pending': pend_out}
exact = sorted({r['address'] for g in (layout_out, unit_out) for r in g if r['exact']})
PROPOSALS = {
    'humanoid/Humanoid.h (new native header, Humanoid owner)':
        'static PartInstance* getHeadFromCharacter(const ModelInstance* character); /*005d75a0*/ in class Humanoid : '
        'DescribedCreatable<Humanoid, Instance, sHumanoid> (extern char sHumanoid[]; RTTI 3PADA). With it, the '
        'PartByLocalCharacter constructor 00660380 is exact (pending build)',
    'v8datamodel/PartInstance.h (PartInstance owner)':
        'getTransparencyUi() { return 1.0f - (1.0f - transparency) * alphaModifier; } (getIsTransparent 006601c0: '
        'fld1; fld st0; fsub [+0x1e8]; fmul [+0x328]; fsubp; > 0.1f) with alphaModifier at +0x328, i.e. after the '
        'Primitive embedded at +0x228 (already proposed)',
}
receipt = {
    'class': 'RBX::HitTestFilter family (Unlocked, PartByLocalCharacter, UnlockedPartByLocalCharacter, FilterStairs, '
             'FilterCharacterOcclusion)',
    'compiler': 'MSVC 15.00.21022 (VS2008 RTM)',
    'flags': {'layout': layout_flags, 'unit': unit_flags, 'pending': pend_flags},
    'sources': {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\', '/'): sha(p) for p in paths},
    'objects': {p.name: sha(p) for p in objects},
    'layout': {'PartByLocalCharacter': '0x14: character shared_ptr +0x04, head shared_ptr +0x0c (ctor 00660380)',
               'UnlockedPartByLocalCharacter': '0x14, no own fields (vtable 00843a50)',
               'FilterStairs': '0x0c: model shared_ptr<Instance> +0x04 (ctor 006604a0)',
               'Unlocked': '4', 'FilterCharacterOcclusion': '4'},
    'rows': groups,
    'exact_function_rows': exact,
    'vtables': vt,
    'rtti_bases': rtti,
    'proposals': PROPOSALS,
    'scope': 'Inactive. Exact bodies with verified call/data targets; no active build, swap or credit.',
}
(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/hit-filters-working.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print('PASS native hit filters: %d distinct function rows exact (layout %d, unit %d); %d pending-build-only rows '
      '(%d exact there) and %d non-exact rows not counted; targets, %d vtables and RTTI verified'
      % (len(exact), sum(r['exact'] for r in layout_out), sum(r['exact'] for r in unit_out),
         len(pend_out), sum(r['exact_pending_build_only'] for r in pend_out), len(non_out), len(vt)))

"""Verify the inactive native RBX::Hopper family and RBX::Tool recovery (2008-06).

Builds (document-swap flags, VS2008 RTM 21022, native headers only):
  * tests/NativeHopperLayout.cpp   layout probes (mov eax, imm32; ret) against allocation sizes and constructor stores;
  * native-classes/Hopper.cpp      Hopper / StarterPackService / LegacyHopperService / BackpackItem / HopperBin
                                   (the original Hopper unit 005cf160..005d1670, initializers 007f5df0..007f5ef0), /fp:fast;
  * native-classes/Tool.cpp        Tool (005fd3a0..006004d0, initializers 007f7640..007f7990), /fp:fast.
Pending builds (rows recorded exact=false, pending-build-only, never counted, vtables never walked):
  * Hopper.cpp with NATIVE_HOPPER_PENDING and Backpack.cpp with NATIVE_BACKPACK_PENDING against
    out/native-layouts/hopper-pending: a generated copy of the donor script/Script.h with the 2008 const-char-array
    class names (`extern const char sScript[]` / `sLocalScript[]`), which Backpack.h needs for IScriptOwner;
  * Tool.cpp with NATIVE_TOOL_PENDING against a generated copy of the native v8tree/Service.h plus the one declaration
    `static const ServiceProvider* findServiceProvider(const Instance* context);` (004898d0 in the original).

Rows are found by closure from a few seeds (constructors named by the factories that allocate the objects, the dynamic
initializers, and a handful of evidence-named leaves): every REL32/DIR32 relocation of an exact row is bound to the
address the original instruction uses. A target defined in the compiled object becomes a row at that address; a
vtable target is checked by original RTTI (class name and subobject offset) and walked slot by slot, each slot
symbol bound to the original slot value (main builds only). Every other target is verified: imports by DLL export
name, string literals and class-name arrays by bytes, type descriptors by RTTI name, external functions by the
evidence name or the EXTERNAL map (call sites read in the original disassembly). A symbol binds to one address.
Rows of other classes' inline functions reached this way (GuiItem/Widget/Instance inlines, reflection templates) are
recorded as support rows and not counted. Writes work/2008-06/shared-layouts/hopper-family-working.json.
"""
import json
import re
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from roc import match, rebuild  # noqa: E402
import native_bind as nb  # noqa: E402

R = ROOT / 'rebuild/2008-06'
OUT = nb.OUT
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
HOPPER_SRC = R / 'native-classes/Hopper.cpp'
TOOL_SRC = R / 'native-classes/Tool.cpp'
BACKPACK_SRC = R / 'native-classes/Backpack.cpp'

def norm(symbol):
    return symbol.replace('3QBDB', '3PBDB').replace('3PADA', '3PBDB')


# Allocation sizes: each factory pushes the size, calls operator new, then the constructor.
for factory, size, ctor in ((0x48e790, 0x1a8, 0x5d15a0), (0x48ea00, 0x168, 0x5d0fc0), (0x48ec70, 0x168, 0x5d10a0),
                            (0x48bc20, 0x16c, 0x5d1a80), (0x578400, 0x270, 0x600240)):
    body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % factory)
    at = body.index(b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size))
    call = body.index(b'\xe8', at + 5)
    while (factory + call + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', body, call + 1)[0]) & 0xffffffff != ctor:
        call = body.index(b'\xe8', call + 1)


def bases(vtable):
    hierarchy = d(d(vtable - 4) + 16)
    out = {}
    for i in range(d(hierarchy + 8)):
        bcd = d(d(hierarchy + 12) + 4 * i)
        out.setdefault(original.string(d(bcd) + 8), struct.unpack('<i', original.data(bcd + 8, 4))[0])
    return out

def own_vtable(rtti):
    if any(rtti.startswith('.?AV%s@RBX@@' % c) for c in OWN_CLASSES.split('|')):
        return True
    return rtti.startswith('.?AV?$') and any('$1?s%s@2@' % c in rtti for c in OWN_CLASSES.split('|') + ['StarterPackService', 'LegacyHopperService'])


class Build:
    def __init__(self, name, obj, walk_vtables):
        self.name, self.obj, self.walk = name, Path(obj), walk_vtables
        self.raw = self.obj.read_bytes()
        self.sections, self.symbols, self.definitions, self.starts = match._coff_data_index(self.raw)
        self.bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(self.raw)}
        self.binding = {}     # symbol -> (address, origin)
        self.rows = {}        # address -> row
        self.vtables = {}
        self.queue = []

    def bind(self, symbol, value, origin):
        prev = self.binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, origin))
        assert prev[0] == value, (self.name, 'inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), origin)

    def literal(self, symbol):
        pos, at = self.definitions[symbol]
        table = self.sections[at]
        return self.raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + table[3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'

    def classify(self, symbol, value, where):
        if symbol in self.bodies and not LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            self.bind(symbol, value, where)
            self.queue.append((value, symbol))
            return 'own row'
        if symbol.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + symbol[4:] in self.bodies:
            # vector deleting destructor referenced, scalar one compiled: the same body in the original
            self.bind('??_G' + symbol[4:], value, where)
            self.queue.append((value, '??_G' + symbol[4:]))
            return 'own row (??_G)'
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            return '%s!%s' % hit
        if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            lit = self.literal(symbol)
            assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'literal %r' % lit[:-1].decode()
        if re.match(r'^\?s[A-Z]\w*@RBX@@3QBDB$', symbol):
            lit = self.literal(symbol) if symbol in self.definitions else CLASS_NAMES[symbol[1:symbol.index('@')]] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'class name %r' % lit[:-1].decode()
        if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
        if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            if self.walk and symbol in self.definitions:
                self.bind(symbol, value, where)
                self.queue.append((value, symbol))
            return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        if symbol.startswith('??_8'):
            return 'vbtable (bound by consistency)'
        if symbol in FOLDED:
            assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'folded'
        if symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
        if symbol in DATA:
            assert DATA[symbol][0] == value and original.data(value, len(DATA[symbol][1])) == DATA[symbol][1], (where, symbol)
            return 'constant %s' % DATA[symbol][1].hex()
        if symbol in UNPROVEN:
            assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'own function not attempted (bound by the original reference)'
        if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) and symbol not in self.definitions:
            return 'external (evidence name)'
        if symbol in self.definitions and symbol not in self.bodies:
            # own static data (descriptor objects, local statics, guard flags): bound by consistency across rows
            return 'own static'
        return None

    def vtable(self, symbol, value):
        start, sec = self.definitions[symbol]
        table = self.sections[sec]
        end = min([x for x in self.starts[sec + 1] if x > start] + [table[3]])
        slots = {}
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            if start <= offset < end:
                slots[(offset - start) // 4] = self.symbols[index][0]
        assert slots and max(slots) == len(slots) - 1, (symbol, sorted(slots))
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        own = own_vtable(rtti)
        after = d(value + 4 * len(slots))
        longer = TEXT_LO <= after < TEXT_HI
        info = {'address': hex(value), 'rtti': rtti, 'offset': hex(at), 'own_class': own}
        self.vtables[symbol] = info
        if longer:
            # The dword after the compiled length is a code address in the original. For the classes' own
            # most-derived vtables (offset 0) that would be a missing virtual: asserted. Elsewhere it can also be
            # unrelated .rdata that follows the vtable (FactoryProduct<Tool> 00841904 is followed by a boost::function
            # manager table 005fdec0 / 00618cd0): recorded only.
            assert not (own and at == 0 and any(rtti == '.?AV%s@RBX@@' % c for c in OWN_CLASSES.split('|'))), \
                (symbol, hex(value), 'original vtable longer', hex(after))
            info['next_dword_is_code'] = 'slot %d position holds %s in the original' % (len(slots), hex(after))
            if not own:
                info['not_walked'] = 'shared template vtable; length not proven'
                return
        checked = {}
        for slot, sym in sorted(slots.items()):
            orig = d(value + 4 * slot)
            where = '%s slot %d' % (symbol, slot)
            if sym in self.bodies or sym.startswith('??_7') or sym.startswith('??_R'):
                how = self.classify(sym, orig, where)
                if how is None:
                    UNBOUND.append('%s: vtable %s slot %d %s -> %s' % (self.name, symbol, slot, sym, hex(orig)))
                    continue
                self.bind(sym, orig, where)
            else:
                # Inherited external virtual: verified after all builds (evidence name, EXTERNAL map, or the same
                # address at every other place the symbol occurs).
                SLOTS.append((self.name, own, sym, orig, where))
                how = 'external slot'
            checked[slot] = '%s = %s (%s)' % (sym, hex(orig), how)
        info['slots'] = checked

    def row(self, address, name):
        if address in self.rows and self.rows[address]['symbol'] == name:
            return
        body, refs = self.bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
                 'exact': exact, 'counted_class': bool(OWN.search(name))}
        key = address if address not in self.rows else (address, name)
        self.rows[key] = entry
        if not exact:
            return
        start, section = self.definitions[name]
        table = self.sections[section]
        code = self.raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = self.symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = self.classify(symbol, value, name)
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append('%s: %s in %s -> %s' % (self.name, symbol, name, hex(value)))
                continue
            self.bind(symbol, value, name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})

    def run(self, seeds):
        for address, name in seeds:
            assert name in self.bodies, (self.name, name)
            self.bind(name, address, 'seed')
            self.queue.append((address, name))

OWN_CLASSES = 'Hopper|StarterPackService|LegacyHopperService|BackpackItem|HopperBin|Backpack|Tool'
# Classes whose rows count (template instances parameterized on them included).
OWN = re.compile(r'(Hopper|StarterPackService|LegacyHopperService|BackpackItem|HopperBin|Backpack|Tool)@RBX@@'
                 r'|\?\?__[EF](desc_|prop_|event_|\?prop_Enabled@Tool)|sBackpackItem|sHopperBin|sStarterPackService'

    '005d18e0': 'Backpack::scriptShouldRun (Workspace IScriptOwner +0x340, Players::backendProcessing)',
    '005fd460..005ffdd0': 'Tool state machine (computeDesiredState, upTo_/downFrom_ chains, onEvent_*, setGrip, '

                          'here only reached from the pending getMouse 005ff680',

LOCAL_EH = nb.LOCAL_EH
UNBOUND = []
SLOTS = []   # (build, own vtable, symbol, original value, where)
HEADER_GAPS = []


def own_vtable(rtti):
    if any(rtti.startswith('.?AV%s@RBX@@' % c) for c in OWN_CLASSES.split('|')):
        return True
    return rtti.startswith('.?AV?$') and any('$1?s%s@2@' % c in rtti for c in OWN_CLASSES.split('|') + ['StarterPackService', 'LegacyHopperService'])


class Build:
    def __init__(self, name, obj, walk_vtables):
        self.name, self.obj, self.walk = name, Path(obj), walk_vtables
        self.raw = self.obj.read_bytes()
        self.sections, self.symbols, self.definitions, self.starts = match._coff_data_index(self.raw)
        self.bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(self.raw)}
        self.binding = {}     # symbol -> (address, origin)
        self.rows = {}        # address -> row
        self.vtables = {}
        self.queue = []

    def bind(self, symbol, value, origin):
        prev = self.binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, origin))
        assert prev[0] == value, (self.name, 'inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), origin)

    def literal(self, symbol):
        pos, at = self.definitions[symbol]
        table = self.sections[at]
        return self.raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + table[3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'

    def classify(self, symbol, value, where):
        if symbol in self.bodies and not LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            self.bind(symbol, value, where)
            self.queue.append((value, symbol))
            return 'own row'
        if symbol.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + symbol[4:] in self.bodies:
            # vector deleting destructor referenced, scalar one compiled: the same body in the original
            self.bind('??_G' + symbol[4:], value, where)
            self.queue.append((value, '??_G' + symbol[4:]))
            return 'own row (??_G)'
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            return '%s!%s' % hit
        if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            lit = self.literal(symbol)
            assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'literal %r' % lit[:-1].decode()
        if re.match(r'^\?s[A-Z]\w*@RBX@@3QBDB$', symbol):
            lit = self.literal(symbol) if symbol in self.definitions else CLASS_NAMES[symbol[1:symbol.index('@')]] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'class name %r' % lit[:-1].decode()
        if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
        if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            if self.walk and symbol in self.definitions:
                self.bind(symbol, value, where)
                self.queue.append((value, symbol))
            return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        if symbol.startswith('??_8'):
            return 'vbtable (bound by consistency)'
        if symbol in FOLDED:
            assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'folded'
        if symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
        if symbol in DATA:
            assert DATA[symbol][0] == value and original.data(value, len(DATA[symbol][1])) == DATA[symbol][1], (where, symbol)
            return 'constant %s' % DATA[symbol][1].hex()
        if symbol in UNPROVEN:
            assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'own function not attempted (bound by the original reference)'
        if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) and symbol not in self.definitions:
            return 'external (evidence name)'
        if symbol in self.definitions and symbol not in self.bodies:
            # own static data (descriptor objects, local statics, guard flags): bound by consistency across rows
            return 'own static'
        return None

    def vtable(self, symbol, value):
        start, sec = self.definitions[symbol]
        table = self.sections[sec]
        end = min([x for x in self.starts[sec + 1] if x > start] + [table[3]])
        slots = {}
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            if start <= offset < end:
                slots[(offset - start) // 4] = self.symbols[index][0]
        assert slots and max(slots) == len(slots) - 1, (symbol, sorted(slots))
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        own = own_vtable(rtti)
        after = d(value + 4 * len(slots))
        longer = TEXT_LO <= after < TEXT_HI
        info = {'address': hex(value), 'rtti': rtti, 'offset': hex(at), 'own_class': own}
        self.vtables[symbol] = info
        if longer:
            # The dword after the compiled length is a code address in the original. For the classes' own
            # most-derived vtables (offset 0) that would be a missing virtual: asserted. Elsewhere it can also be
            # unrelated .rdata that follows the vtable (FactoryProduct<Tool> 00841904 is followed by a boost::function
            # manager table 005fdec0 / 00618cd0): recorded only.
            assert not (own and at == 0 and any(rtti == '.?AV%s@RBX@@' % c for c in OWN_CLASSES.split('|'))), \
                (symbol, hex(value), 'original vtable longer', hex(after))
            info['next_dword_is_code'] = 'slot %d position holds %s in the original' % (len(slots), hex(after))
            if not own:
                info['not_walked'] = 'shared template vtable; length not proven'
                return
        checked = {}
        for slot, sym in sorted(slots.items()):
            orig = d(value + 4 * slot)
            where = '%s slot %d' % (symbol, slot)
            if sym in self.bodies or sym.startswith('??_7') or sym.startswith('??_R'):
                how = self.classify(sym, orig, where)
                if how is None:
                    UNBOUND.append('%s: vtable %s slot %d %s -> %s' % (self.name, symbol, slot, sym, hex(orig)))
                    continue
                self.bind(sym, orig, where)
            else:
                # Inherited external virtual: verified after all builds (evidence name, EXTERNAL map, or the same
                # address at every other place the symbol occurs).
                SLOTS.append((self.name, own, sym, orig, where))
                how = 'external slot'
            checked[slot] = '%s = %s (%s)' % (sym, hex(orig), how)
        info['slots'] = checked

    def row(self, address, name):
        if address in self.rows and self.rows[address]['symbol'] == name:
            return
        body, refs = self.bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
                 'exact': exact, 'counted_class': bool(OWN.search(name))}
        key = address if address not in self.rows else (address, name)
        self.rows[key] = entry
        if not exact:
            return
        start, section = self.definitions[name]
        table = self.sections[section]
        code = self.raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = self.symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = self.classify(symbol, value, name)
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append('%s: %s in %s -> %s' % (self.name, symbol, name, hex(value)))
                continue
            self.bind(symbol, value, name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})

    def run(self, seeds):
        for address, name in seeds:
            assert name in self.bodies, (self.name, name)
            self.bind(name, address, 'seed')
            self.queue.append((address, name))
        while self.queue:
            value, symbol = self.queue.pop(0)
            if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                if symbol not in self.vtables:
                    self.vtable(symbol, value)
            else:
                self.row(value, symbol)
        return self


hopper = Build('hopper', hopper_obj, True).run(HOPPER_SEEDS)
tool = Build('tool', tool_obj, True).run(TOOL_SEEDS)
pending_builds = [Build('hopper-pending', hopper_p_obj, False).run(HOPPER_PENDING_SEEDS),
                  Build('backpack-pending', backpack_p_obj, False).run(BACKPACK_PENDING_SEEDS),
                  Build('tool-pending', tool_p_obj, False).run(TOOL_PENDING_SEEDS)]
# External vtable slots: one address per symbol across every vtable and relocation binding of the main builds.
occurrences = {}
for build in (hopper, tool):
    for symbol, (value, origin) in build.binding.items():
        occurrences.setdefault(symbol, set()).add((value, build.name + ': ' + origin))
for build, own, symbol, value, where in SLOTS:
    occurrences.setdefault(symbol, set()).add((value, build + ': ' + where))
SLOT_CHECK = {}
for build, own, symbol, value, where in SLOTS:
    values = {v for v, _ in occurrences[symbol]}
    if len(values) > 1:
        assert not own, ('inconsistent external slot in an own vtable', symbol, sorted(occurrences[symbol]))
        HEADER_GAPS.append('%s: %s -> %s, but %s elsewhere (the shared header lacks an override)'
                           % (where, symbol, hex(value), sorted(hex(v) for v in values - {value})))
        continue
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (symbol, hex(value))
        how = 'external'
    elif norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol):
        how = 'evidence name'
    elif len({w for _, w in occurrences[symbol]}) > 1:
        how = 'same address at %d places' % len({w for _, w in occurrences[symbol]})
    else:
        UNBOUND.append('%s: unverified external slot %s -> %s (%s)' % (build, symbol, hex(value), where))
        continue
    SLOT_CHECK['%s | %s' % (where, symbol)] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
assert not UNBOUND, '\n'.join(sorted(set(UNBOUND)))

# The same symbol compiled in two main units (shared template instances) must bind to the same address.
for symbol, (value, _) in hopper.binding.items():
    if symbol in tool.binding:
        assert tool.binding[symbol][0] == value, (symbol, hex(value), hex(tool.binding[symbol][0]))

# Key rows that must be exact in the main builds.
REQUIRED = {
    'hopper': [0x5cf900, 0x5d0fc0, 0x5d10a0, 0x5d0c10, 0x5cfe50, 0x5d15a0, 0x5d0910, 0x5cf1c0, 0x5cf160, 0x5cf190,
               0x5d1340, 0x5d1670],
    'tool': [0x600240, 0x5fe4b0, 0x5fd770, 0x5c3810, 0x5ff8d0, 0x5ffc00, 0x6004b0, 0x6004d0, 0x5fd500, 0x5fd530],
}
for build in (hopper, tool):
    for address in REQUIRED[build.name]:
        hits = [r for k, r in build.rows.items() if (k if isinstance(k, int) else k[0]) == address]
        assert hits and all(r['exact'] for r in hits), (build.name, hex(address), hits)
pending_rows = []
for build in pending_builds:
    for row in build.rows.values():
        main = [r for r in list(hopper.rows.values()) + list(tool.rows.values())
                if r['address'] == row['address'] and r['symbol'] == row['symbol'] and r['exact']]
        if main:
            continue   # also exact in a main build: counted there
        row['exact_pending_build_only'] = row['exact']
        row['exact'] = False
        pending_rows.append(dict(row, build=build.name))

main_rows = list(hopper.rows.values()) + list(tool.rows.values())
# Unit ranges of the original Hopper and Tool units (and their initializer / atexit stretches). Outside them only
# class-specific template instances count (a class-name template argument of these classes); ICF-shared generic
# bodies reached through these classes' vtables (`return true` 00565ff0, empty 0047d410, RelativePanel thunks) are
# exact support rows, not counted.
UNIT_RANGES = ((0x5cf100, 0x5d1ba0), (0x5fd300, 0x600600), (0x7f5df0, 0x7f5f20), (0x7f7640, 0x7f79c0),
               (0x7fe000, 0x800200))
CLASS_ARG = re.compile(r'\$1\?s(%s)@' % (OWN_CLASSES + '|StarterPackService|LegacyHopperService'))


def counts(address):
    a = int(address, 16)
    syms = [r['symbol'] for r in main_rows if r['address'] == address and r['exact']]
    if not syms or not all(r['exact'] for r in main_rows if r['address'] == address):
        return False
    if any(lo <= a < hi for lo, hi in UNIT_RANGES):
        return any(OWN.search(x) for x in syms)
    return all(OWN.search(x) for x in syms) and any(CLASS_ARG.search(x) for x in syms)


counted = sorted({r['address'] for r in main_rows if counts(r['address'])})
support = sorted({r['address'] for r in main_rows if r['exact']} - set(counted))
inexact = list({(r['address'], r['symbol']): r for r in main_rows if not r['exact']}.values())
sha = nb.sha
paths = [Path(__file__).resolve(), LAYOUT, HOPPER_SRC, TOOL_SRC, BACKPACK_SRC] + HEADERS

"""Verify the inactive native RBX::Humanoid recovery (2008-06), header native-headers/humanoid/Humanoid2008.h.

Builds (document-swap flags + /fp:fast /U_RELEASEASSERT, VS2008 RTM 21022):
  * tests/NativeHumanoid2008Layout.cpp   sizeof / base-offset probes (mov eax, imm32; ret) and compile-time field
                                         offset asserts;
  * native-classes/Humanoid2008.cpp      the original unit's bodies that do not need a complete PartInstance
                                         (constructor, destructor, descriptors, setters, virtual leaves);
  * native-classes/Humanoid2008Parts.cpp the bodies that need a complete PartInstance (limb getters, part setters,
                                         takeDamage, moveTo2, the Torso/LeftLeg/RightLeg/WalkToPart descriptors). The
                                         native PartInstance.h reaches the donor v8kernel/Connector.h, which cannot
                                         share a translation unit with v8kernel/Connector2008.h, so this unit selects
                                         the donor Connector (same Connector size; it defines no virtuals and no
                                         vtable of this unit is checked from it);
  * both units again with NATIVE_HUMANOID2008_PENDING against out/native-layouts/humanoid2008-pending/: a generated
    copy of the native v8datamodel/ModelInstance.h with the proposed member template findModifierOfType<T>, and
    tests/NativeHumanoid2008PendingWorkspace.h copied as v8datamodel/Workspace.h (declaration-only overlay: the donor
    Workspace.h fails with C2440 on &sWorkspace). Rows exact only in these builds are recorded exact=false
    (pending-build-only) and are not counted.

Every row must be relocation-masked exact against the original, and every REL32/DIR32 target is bound to the
address the original instruction uses and verified: imports by DLL export name, string literals by bytes, float
constants by bits, type descriptors and vtables by original RTTI names, own symbols by a row proven here,
descriptor statics and the class-name array by the DATA map (the `this` / operand the original initializers and
setters use), and the remaining externals by the EXTERNAL map (call sites read in the original disassembly). Rows
are the SEEDS plus their closure: a call/jump target, atexit function or vtable slot defined in the same object is
added as a row only when its compiled body is exact at the address the original uses. A symbol binds to one address
in every row. Each Humanoid / FactoryProduct / DescribedCreatable vtable of the main build (never the pending one) is
compared slot by slot with the original vtable it binds to. Writes work/2008-06/shared-layouts/humanoid2008-working.json.
"""

import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

def functions(obj):
    return {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())}


def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key)
                                                       and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        assert len(hits) == 1, (hex(address), key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def target(address):
    try:
        return match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    except Exception:
        return None


def exact_at(obj_funcs, symbol, address):
    if symbol not in obj_funcs:
        return False
    t = target(address)
    if t is None:
        return False
    body, refs = obj_funcs[symbol]
    return len(body) == len(t[0]) and match.exact_match(t[0], t[1], body, refs)


def relocations(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, size):
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if 0 <= offset < size:
            yield offset, symbols[index][0], kind


def vtable_slots(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, starts, symbol):
    value, sec = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[sec]
    end = min([x for x in starts[sec + 1] if x > value] + [table[3]])
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if value <= offset < end:
            slots[(offset - value) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return slots

    referencing row is verified). Slots are followed only for the Humanoid descriptor templates (GetSetImpl,
    PropDescriptor, SignalDesc, BoundFuncDesc instances over Humanoid), not into the shared signal/runtime classes."""
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    funcs = functions(obj)
    rows = list(rows)
    seen = {name for _, name in rows}
    seen_vt = set()
    i = 0
    while i < len(rows):

        body, refs = funcs[name]
        t = target(address)
        for offset, symbol, kind in relocations(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, len(body)):
            if symbol.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + symbol[4:] in funcs:
                symbol = '??_G' + symbol[4:]
            if symbol.startswith('??_7') and 'Humanoid@RBX@@' in symbol and symbol in definitions and kind != 20 \
                    and symbol not in seen_vt:
                seen_vt.add(symbol)
                code = raw[sections[definitions[name][1]][4] + definitions[name][0]:]
                vt = (struct.unpack_from('<I', t[0], offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
                for slot, sym in vtable_slots(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, starts, symbol).items():
                    if sym.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + sym[4:] in funcs:
                        sym = '??_G' + sym[4:]
                    if sym not in seen and sym in funcs and exact_at(funcs, sym, d(vt + 4 * slot)):
                        rows.append((d(vt + 4 * slot), sym))
                        seen.add(sym)
                continue
            if symbol in seen or symbol not in funcs or LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                continue
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', t[0], offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', t[0], offset)[0]
                         - struct.unpack_from('<i', raw, definitions[name][0] + sections[definitions[name][1]][4] + offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if exact_at(funcs, symbol, value):
                rows.append((value, symbol))
                seen.add(symbol)
        i += 1
    return rows


def data_name(symbol):
    """`?name@RBX@@3...`, `?name@Humanoid@RBX@@2...` or the internal-linkage `_name` -> DATA key."""
    if symbol.startswith('_') and symbol[1:] in DATA:
        return symbol[1:]
    for key in DATA:
        short = key.split('::')[-1]
        prefix = '?%s@%sRBX@@' % (short, 'Humanoid@' if key.startswith('Humanoid::') else '')
        if symbol.startswith(prefix) and symbol[len(prefix)] in '23':
            return key
    return None


def classify(symbol, value, own, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('__real@') and len(symbol) == 15:
        bits = struct.pack('<I', int(symbol[7:], 16))
        assert original.data(value, 4) == bits, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'float constant %r' % struct.unpack('<f', bits)
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol.startswith('??_8'):
        cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@7B') + 2]
        return None if cls != HU else 'vbtable (checked below)'
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
        assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'own row (??_G)'
    if symbol.startswith('__TI') and '?AV' in symbol:
        # _ThrowInfo -> CatchableTypeArray -> first CatchableType -> TypeDescriptor name
        cta = d(value + 12)
        first = d(cta + 4)
        rtti = original.string(d(first + 4) + 8)
        assert rtti == '.' + symbol[symbol.index('?AV'):], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'throw info %s' % rtti
    key = data_name(symbol)
    if key is not None:
        assert DATA[key] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(DATA[key]))
        return 'data %s' % key
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
        return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
    if symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?flag@') \
            or symbol.startswith('?foo@') or symbol.startswith('?root@') or symbol.startswith('?n@?1???$doDeclare@'):
        return 'local static'
    return None


def verify(obj, rows, own):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    funcs = functions(obj)
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = funcs[name]
        t, t_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        assert match.exact_match(t, t_refs, body, refs), (name, hex(address), len(body), len(t))
        code = raw[sections[definitions[name][1]][4] + definitions[name][0]:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for offset, symbol, kind in relocations(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, len(body)):
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', t, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', t, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = classify(symbol, value, own, raw, sections, definitions, name)
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append('%s in %s -> %s' % (symbol, name, hex(value)))
                continue
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        result.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'exact': True,
                       'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return result

def target_of(address):
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return body, refs


def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', '%08x' % address, key[:120], [h[0][:120] for h in hits])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def verify(obj, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in FOLDED:
                assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'folded'
            elif symbol in DATA:
                assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'data'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
            elif symbol in UNPROVEN:
                assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'call target of a non-exact row'
            elif symbol in SLOT_EXTERNAL:
                assert SLOT_EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'call target bound at the call site (row not built / pending)'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('??_B?3??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol:
                how = 'local static'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result
