def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address):
    """Each slot holds the address bound to its symbol (row, fold, external) or the evidence name."""
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            expect, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]], 'bound (??_G)'
        else:
            expect, how = slot_names.get(slot), 'bound'
        ok = expect == value if expect is not None else norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(slot)
        if expect is None:
            how = 'evidence name'
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value)))
    assert not bad, (symbol, bad)
    return out

def bases(vtable):
    hierarchy = d(d(vtable - 4) + 16)
    out = {}
    for i in range(d(hierarchy + 8)):
        bcd = d(d(hierarchy + 12) + 4 * i)
        out.setdefault(original.string(d(bcd) + 8), struct.unpack('<i', original.data(bcd + 8, 4))[0])
    return out

                              '+0x60 = 0, +0x54 = float 0082d030, +0x64 / +0x68 = -1 (used as NormalId + 6 by 006087a0), '
                              'byte +0x5c read by 006087a0); +0x6c..+0x7b are never written by the constructor and '
                              'their types are not derived yet (stepContact / computeIsColliding 00607ea0..00608580). '
                              'Not declared: no field may be invented (also Contact2008.h is colin-leased).',
    'RBX::Point::step/forceToBody/setWorldPos': '2008 Body layout (see proposals)',
    'RBX::Link::getChildInParent': '2008 Body layout (see proposals)',
    'RBX::RevoluteLink::computeChildInParent': 'undeclared helper 005989d0 (see proposals)',
}

LOCAL_EH = nb.LOCAL_EH
UNBOUND = []
binding = {}   # symbol -> (address, row) for the one-address-per-symbol check


def target_of(address):
    """Original bytes and relocation offsets of one row, of contiguous rows concatenated, or of a slice of one row."""
    if isinstance(address, tuple) and address[0] == 'slice':
        _, row, lo, hi = address
        body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % row)
        assert len(body) >= hi, (hex(row), len(body), hi)
        return body[lo:hi], [r - lo for r in refs if lo <= r < hi]
    parts = address if isinstance(address, tuple) else (address,)
    code, relocs = b'', []
    for part in parts:
        assert part == parts[0] + len(code), ('rows not contiguous', [hex(p) for p in parts])
        body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % part)
        relocs += [r + len(code) for r in refs]
        code += body
    return code, relocs


def first(address):
    if isinstance(address, tuple) and address[0] == 'slice':
        return address[1] + address[2]
    return address[0] if isinstance(address, tuple) else address


def label(address):
    if isinstance(address, tuple) and address[0] == 'slice':
        return '%08x[%02x:%02x]' % address[1:]
    return '+'.join('%08x' % a for a in (address if isinstance(address, tuple) else (address,)))


def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key)
                                                       and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        assert len(hits) == 1, (hex(first(address)), key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def classify(symbol, value, own, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    """Return how a relocation target bound to `value` is verified, or None when unknown."""
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('__real@') and len(symbol) == 15:
        bits = struct.pack('<I', int(symbol[7:], 16))
        assert original.data(value, 4) == bits, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'float constant %r' % struct.unpack('<f', bits)
    if symbol.startswith('__real@') and len(symbol) == 23:
        bits = struct.pack('<Q', int(symbol[7:], 16))
        assert original.data(value, 8) == bits, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'double constant %r' % struct.unpack('<d', bits)
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
        assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'own row (??_G)'
    if symbol in FOLDED:
        assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'folded'
    if symbol in DATA:
        assert DATA[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(DATA[symbol]))
        return 'data'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
        return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
    if symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?n@?1??') \
            or symbol.startswith('?standardOut@?1??'):
        return 'local static'
    return None


def verify(obj, rows, own):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        assert match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (name, label(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        base = first(address)
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (base + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = classify(symbol, value, own, raw, sections, definitions, name)
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append('%s in %s -> %s' % (symbol, name, hex(value)))
                continue
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        result.append({'address': label(address), 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'exact': True,
                       'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return result

    '?print@StandardOut@RBX@@QAAXW4MessageType@2@PBDZZ': (0x5693a0, 'evidence name'),
    '?singleton@StandardOut@RBX@@SA?AV?$shared_ptr@VStandardOut@RBX@@@boost@@XZ': (0x569620, 'evidence name'),

    '?AtlThrowImpl@ATL@@YGXJ@Z': (0x401000, 'atls.lib AtlThrowImpl (library body, not this unit); same address as '
                                            'record_native_output_view; ThrowMemoryException 004066b0 calls it'),
    '?empty@InstanceHandle@RBX@@QBE_NXZ': (0x4dc3d0, 'evidence name'),

    ('00443cf0', 'std::vector<IDREFItem>::~vector (111 bytes): not emitted here (no MergeBinder destructor is '
                 'instantiated by this unit; ArchiveBinder and stack users destroy it).'),
]

LOCAL_EH = nb.LOCAL_EH
binding = {}


def target_of(address):
    parts = address if isinstance(address, tuple) else (address,)
    code, relocs = b'', []
    for part in parts:
        assert part == parts[0] + len(code), ('extents not contiguous', [hex(p) for p in parts])
        body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % part)
        relocs += [r + len(code) for r in refs]
        code += body
    return code, relocs


def first(address):
    return address[0] if isinstance(address, tuple) else address


def throw_info_type(value):
    array = d(value + 12)
    assert d(array) >= 1
    return original.string(d(d(array + 4) + 4) + 8)


def verify(obj, rows, own):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    funcs = match.coff_functions(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in funcs}
    result = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x[0] for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or \
               [x[0] for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        assert len(hits) == 1, (key, hits)
        name = hits[0]
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        assert match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (name, hex(first(address)), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        base = first(address)
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (base + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol.startswith('__TI'):
                cls = symbol[symbol.index('?'):]
                assert throw_info_type(value) == '.' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), throw_info_type(value))
                how = 'throw info, first catchable type .%s' % cls
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            else:
                assert symbol in EXTERNAL and EXTERNAL[symbol][0] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                why = EXTERNAL[symbol][1]
                if why == 'evidence name':
                    assert names.get(value) == symbol, (symbol, hex(value), names.get(value))
                how = 'external (%s)' % why
            assert binding.setdefault(symbol, value) == value, ('two addresses', symbol, hex(binding[symbol]), hex(value))
            verified[symbol] = '%s %s' % (hex(value), how)
        result.append({'address': '+'.join('%08x' % a for a in (address if isinstance(address, tuple) else (address,))),
                       'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'exact': True, 'verified_targets': verified,
                       'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return result


def resolve_names(obj, rows):
    funcs = [x[0] for x in match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())]
    out = {}
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [n for n in funcs if n == key] or [n for n in funcs if n.startswith(key) and not LOCAL_EH.match(n)]
        assert len(hits) == 1, (key, hits)
        out[hits[0]] = first(address)
    return out


rows = []
for obj, group in ((md5_obj, 'md5'), (mb_obj, 'mb')):
    rows += verify(obj, ROWS[group], resolve_names(obj, ROWS[group]))
own = {r['symbol']: int(r['address'].split('+')[0], 16) for r in rows}

# ---- vtables (current-header objects) ---------------------------------------------------------------
text = next(x for x in original.pe.sections if x.Name.startswith(b'.text'))
TEXT = (original.image + text.VirtualAddress, original.image + text.VirtualAddress + text.Misc_VirtualSize)


def original_slots(vt):
    n = 0
    while TEXT[0] <= d(vt + 4 * n) < TEXT[1]:
        n += 1
    return n


def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, index = definitions[symbol]
    section = sections[index]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(section[7]):
        offset, sym, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, section[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start and kind == 6:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[sym][0]
    return slots


VTABLES = [(md5_obj, '??_7' + MD5 + '6B@', 0x82dc9c), (mb_obj, '??_7' + MB + '6B@', 0x81593c)]
vtables = []
for obj, symbol, vt in VTABLES:
    assert binding[symbol] == vt, (symbol, hex(binding[symbol]))
    assert original.vtable_class(vt) == ('.?AV' + symbol[4:-3], 0), (hex(vt), original.vtable_class(vt))
    slots = vtable_slots(obj, symbol)
    count = original_slots(vt)
    assert len(slots) == count == 5, (symbol, slots, count)
    entries = {}
    for slot, name in sorted(slots.items()):
        value = d(vt + 4 * slot)
        assert own.get(name) == value, (symbol, slot, name, hex(value))
        entries[slot] = '%s -> %s (own row)' % (name, hex(value))
    vtables.append({'vtable': hex(vt), 'symbol': symbol, 'rtti_offset': 0, 'original_slots': count, 'slots': entries})

# ---- RTTI base lists: Impl -> interface, single inheritance, no virtual base ---------------------------
for vt, cls, iface in ((0x82dc9c, MD5, 'MD5Hasher@RBX@@'), (0x81593c, MB, 'IReferenceBinder@RBX@@')):
    hierarchy = d(d(vt - 4) + 16)
    assert d(hierarchy + 4) == 0, hex(d(hierarchy + 4))
    items = [d(d(hierarchy + 12) + 4 * i) for i in range(d(hierarchy + 8))]
    bases = [(original.string(d(item) + 8), d(item + 4), struct.unpack('<i', original.data(item + 8, 4))[0])
             for item in items]
    assert bases == [('.?AV' + cls, 1, 0), ('.?AV' + iface, 0, 0)], bases

# ---- allocation size: MD5Hasher::create 0055c8b0 -> new(0x28); ArchiveBinder ctor calls ??0MergeBinder ------
body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '0055c8b0')
assert body[0x55c8c6 - 0x55c8b0:][:2] == b'\x6a\x28' and body[0x55c8c8 - 0x55c8b0] == 0xe8
body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '00592940')
at = body[0x59295f - 0x592940:]
assert at[0] == 0xe8 and (0x59295f + 5 + struct.unpack('<i', at[1:5])[0]) & 0xffffffff == 0x443e50
assert body[0x59296d - 0x592940:][:3] == b'\x8d\x4e\x1c'        # ArchiveBinder's own map starts at +0x1c

sha = nb.sha
paths = [Path(__file__).resolve(), MD5_UNIT, MB_UNIT, LAYOUT] + HEADERS
exact_addresses = sorted({a for r in rows for a in r['address'].split('+')})
receipt = {
    'class': 'RBX::MD5HasherImpl (MD5Hasher::create), RBX::MergeBinder',
    'compiler': 'MSVC 15.00.21022 (VS2008 RTM)',
    'flags': {'layout': layout_flags, 'md5': md5_flags, 'mergebinder': mb_flags},
    'sources': {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\', '/'): sha(p) for p in paths},
    'objects': {p.name: sha(p) for p in (layout_obj, md5_obj, mb_obj)},
    'layout': 'MD5HasherImpl 0x28 (hProv +4, hHash +8, std::string result +0xc); MergeBinder 0x1c (vector<IDREFItem> '
              '+4, IDREFItem 0x10); both 5-slot vtables without a destructor slot.',
    'methods': rows, 'not_exact': NOT_EXACT, 'vtables': vtables, 'proposals': [],
    'exact_distinct_addresses': exact_addresses,
    'scope': 'Inactive. Exact bodies with verified call/data targets; no active build, swap or credit.',
}
(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/misc-leaves-working.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print('PASS native MD5HasherImpl/MergeBinder: %d exact rows (%d distinct addresses), %d not-exact; %d vtables; '
      'targets verified' % (len(rows), len(exact_addresses), len(NOT_EXACT), len(vtables)))

REL32/DIR32 relocation of an exact row is bound to the address the original instruction uses. A target defined in the
compiled object becomes a row at that address; a vtable target is checked by original RTTI (class name and subobject

def own_vtable(rtti):
    # Mouse itself and the class templates parameterized on the class-name array; descriptor templates
    # (PropDescriptor<Mouse, T>, SignalDesc<Mouse, ...>) share the reflection header's vtable layout: not own.
    return rtti.startswith('.?AVMouse@RBX@@') or (rtti.startswith('.?AV?$') and '$1?sMouse@2@' in rtti)


class Build:
    def __init__(self, name, obj, walk_vtables):
        self.name, self.obj, self.walk = name, Path(obj), walk_vtables
        self.raw = self.obj.read_bytes()
        self.sections, self.symbols, self.definitions, self.starts = match._coff_data_index(self.raw)
        self.bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(self.raw)}
        self.binding = {}     # symbol -> (address, origin)
        self.rows = {}        # address -> row
        self.vtables = {}
        self.queue = []
        self.split = []       # funclet row addresses proven as the second half of a two-row body

    def bind(self, symbol, value, origin):
        prev = self.binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, origin))
        assert prev[0] == value, (self.name, 'inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), origin)

    def literal(self, symbol):
        pos, at = self.definitions[symbol]
        table = self.sections[at]
        return self.raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + table[3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'

    def classify(self, symbol, value, where):
        if symbol in self.bodies and not LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            self.bind(symbol, value, where)
            self.queue.append((value, symbol))
            return 'own row'
        if symbol.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + symbol[4:] in self.bodies:
            # vector deleting destructor referenced, scalar one compiled: the same body in the original
            self.bind('??_G' + symbol[4:], value, where)
            self.queue.append((value, '??_G' + symbol[4:]))
            return 'own row (??_G)'
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            return '%s!%s' % hit
        if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            lit = self.literal(symbol)
            assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'literal %r' % lit[:-1].decode()
        if re.match(r'^\?s[A-Z]\w*@RBX@@3QBDB$', symbol):
            lit = self.literal(symbol) if symbol in self.definitions else CLASS_NAMES[symbol[1:symbol.index('@')]] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'class name %r' % lit[:-1].decode()
        if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
        if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            if self.walk and symbol in self.definitions:
                self.bind(symbol, value, where)
                self.queue.append((value, symbol))
            return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        if symbol in FOLDED:
            assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'folded'
        if symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
        if symbol in DATA:
            assert DATA[symbol][0] == value and original.data(value, len(DATA[symbol][1])) == DATA[symbol][1], (where, symbol)
            return 'constant %s' % DATA[symbol][1].hex()
        if symbol in UNPROVEN:
            assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'own function not attempted (bound by the original reference)'
        if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) and symbol not in self.definitions:
            return 'external (evidence name)'
        if symbol in self.definitions and symbol not in self.bodies:
            # own static data (descriptor objects, local statics, guard flags): bound by consistency across rows
            return 'own static'
        return None

    def vtable(self, symbol, value):
        start, sec = self.definitions[symbol]
        table = self.sections[sec]
        end = min([x for x in self.starts[sec + 1] if x > start] + [table[3]])
        slots = {}
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            if start <= offset < end:
                slots[(offset - start) // 4] = self.symbols[index][0]
        assert slots and max(slots) == len(slots) - 1, (symbol, sorted(slots))
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        own = own_vtable(rtti)
        after = d(value + 4 * len(slots))
        longer = TEXT_LO <= after < TEXT_HI
        info = {'address': hex(value), 'rtti': rtti, 'offset': hex(at), 'own_class': own}
        self.vtables[symbol] = info
        if longer:
            assert not (own and at == 0 and rtti == '.?AVMouse@RBX@@'), (symbol, hex(value), 'original vtable longer')
            info['next_dword_is_code'] = 'slot %d position holds %s in the original' % (len(slots), hex(after))
            if not own:
                info['not_walked'] = 'shared template vtable; length not proven'
                return
        checked = {}
        for slot, sym in sorted(slots.items()):
            orig = d(value + 4 * slot)
            where = '%s slot %d' % (symbol, slot)
            if sym in self.bodies or sym.startswith('??_7') or sym.startswith('??_R'):
                how = self.classify(sym, orig, where)
                if how is None:
                    UNBOUND.append('%s: vtable %s slot %d %s -> %s' % (self.name, symbol, slot, sym, hex(orig)))
                    continue
                self.bind(sym, orig, where)
            else:
                # Inherited external virtual: verified after the build (evidence name, EXTERNAL map, or the same
                # address at every other place the symbol occurs).
                SLOTS.append((self.name, own, sym, orig, where))
                how = 'external slot'
            checked[slot] = '%s = %s (%s)' % (sym, hex(orig), how)
        info['slots'] = checked

    def row(self, address, name):
        if address in self.rows and self.rows[address]['symbol'] == name:
            return
        body, refs = self.bodies[name]
        status = None
        try:
            target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
            exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
            if not exact and len(target) < len(body):
                # a catch funclet the function list starts as a row of its own (shared_count<Mouse> 005fd9a0 +
                # 005fda0e): compare against the concatenation of the two contiguous rows
                try:
                    tail, tail_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % (address + len(target)))
                except SystemExit:
                    tail = None
                if tail is not None and len(target) + len(tail) == len(body) and match.exact_match(
                        target + tail, list(target_refs) + [len(target) + r for r in tail_refs], body, refs):
                    exact = True
                    status = 'two contiguous rows: %08x + %08x (catch funclet)' % (address, address + len(target))
                    target = target + tail
                    self.split.append('%08x' % (address + len(target) - len(tail)))
            if not exact and len(target) > len(body) and match.exact_match(
                    target[:len(body)], [r for r in target_refs if r < len(body)], body, refs):
                # the analyzed extent runs on into the next function (~Mouse 005ff520 covers ??_G 005ff570)
                status = 'bytes-exact-prefix: analyzed extent %#x covers the next function at %08x' % (
                    len(target), address + len(body) + (-len(body)) % 16)
        except SystemExit:
            # no analyzed function start (??_GMouse 005ff570 sits inside the 005ff520 extent): compare the original
            # bytes directly with this object's relocation fields masked
            target, target_refs = original.data(address, len(body)), []
            exact = False
            if match.exact_match(target, [], body, refs):
                status = 'bytes-exact-no-function-start'
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
                 'exact': exact, 'counted_class': bool(OWN.search(name))}
        if status:
            entry['bounds_status'] = status
        key = address if address not in self.rows else (address, name)
        self.rows[key] = entry
        if not exact and not status:
            return
        start, section = self.definitions[name]
        table = self.sections[section]
        code = self.raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = self.symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = self.classify(symbol, value, name)
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append('%s: %s in %s -> %s' % (self.name, symbol, name, hex(value)))
                continue
            self.bind(symbol, value, name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})

    def run(self, seeds):
        for address, name in seeds:
            if name not in self.bodies:
                hits = [n for n in self.bodies if n.startswith(name) and not LOCAL_EH.match(n)]
                assert len(hits) == 1, (self.name, name, hits)
                name = hits[0]
            self.bind(name, address, 'seed')
            self.queue.append((address, name))
        while self.queue:
            value, symbol = self.queue.pop(0)
            if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                if symbol not in self.vtables:
                    self.vtable(symbol, value)
            else:
                self.row(value, symbol)
        return self


mouse = Build('mouse', main_obj, True).run(SEEDS)
pending_build = Build('mouse-pending', pend_obj, False).run(PENDING_SEEDS)
occurrences = {}
for symbol, (value, origin) in mouse.binding.items():
    occurrences.setdefault(symbol, set()).add((value, 'mouse: ' + origin))
for build, own, symbol, value, where in SLOTS:
    occurrences.setdefault(symbol, set()).add((value, build + ': ' + where))
SLOT_CHECK = {}
for build, own, symbol, value, where in SLOTS:
    values = {v for v, _ in occurrences[symbol]}
    if len(values) > 1:
        assert not own, ('inconsistent external slot in an own vtable', symbol, sorted(occurrences[symbol]))
        HEADER_GAPS.append('%s: %s -> %s, but %s elsewhere (the shared header lacks an override)'
                           % (where, symbol, hex(value), sorted(hex(v) for v in values - {value})))
        continue
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (symbol, hex(value))
        how = 'external'
    elif norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol):
        how = 'evidence name'
    elif symbol in EXTERNAL_SLOTS and not own:
        assert EXTERNAL_SLOTS[symbol] == value, (symbol, hex(value))
        how = 'slot of another class vtable (bound by RTTI)'
    elif len({w for _, w in occurrences[symbol]}) > 1:
        how = 'same address at %d places' % len({w for _, w in occurrences[symbol]})
    else:
        UNBOUND.append('%s: unverified external slot %s -> %s (%s)' % (build, symbol, hex(value), where))
        continue
    SLOT_CHECK['%s | %s' % (where, symbol)] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)

if VERBOSE:
    for r in sorted(mouse.rows.values(), key=lambda r: r['address']):
        print('%s %s %4d/%4d %s %s' % (r['address'], 'EXACT' if r['exact'] else '-----', r['size'], r['target_size'],
                                       r['symbol'][:150], r.get('bounds_status', '')))
    for r in pending_build.rows.values():
        print('pending %s %s %s' % (r['address'], r['exact'], r['symbol'][:150]))

REQUIRED = [0x5ff3b0, 0x5ff600, 0x5fe7f0, 0x64e660, 0x64df60, 0x64e050, 0x64e1a0, 0x64e020, 0x7f8c40, 0x7f8f30]

for row in pending_build.rows.values():

UNIT_RANGES = ((0x64df60, 0x64e840), (0x7f8c40, 0x7f8f70), (0x8010c0, 0x801400), (0x5fd300, 0x600600),

def build(name, src, extra=(), tail=()):
    obj = OUT / (name + '.obj')
    flags = nb.flags()
    i = next(k for k, x in enumerate(flags) if x.replace('\\', '/').endswith('rebuild/2008-06/native-headers'))
    flags = flags[:i] + list(extra) + flags[i:] + list(tail) + ['/Fo' + str(obj), str(src)]
    code, log = rebuild.run(rebuild.toolchain(21022), 'cl', flags, OUT)
    assert code == 0, log
    return obj, flags

def verify(obj, rows, own):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        ok = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        if DISCOVER and not ok:
            print('NOT EXACT', hex(address), name)
            continue
        assert ok, (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
                assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own row (??_G)'
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in DATA:
                assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'data'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?flag@') \
                    or symbol.startswith('?foo@') or symbol.startswith('?n@') or symbol.startswith('?root@') \

                how = 'local static'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append('%s in %s -> %s (%s)' % (symbol, name, hex(value), names.get(value, '')))
                continue
            bind(symbol, value, name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        result.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'exact': True,

def build(name, src, extra=(), tail=()):
    obj = OUT / (name + '.obj')
    flags = nb.flags()
    i = next(k for k, x in enumerate(flags) if x.replace('\\', '/').endswith('rebuild/2008-06/native-headers'))
    flags = flags[:i] + list(extra) + flags[i:] + list(tail) + ['/Fo' + str(obj), str(src)]
    code, log = rebuild.run(rebuild.toolchain(21022), 'cl', flags, OUT)
    assert code == 0, log
    return obj, flags

def resolve(obj, rows):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    funcs = match.coff_functions(raw)
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key)
                                                       and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        assert len(hits) == 1, (hex(address), key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def bind(symbol, value, where):
    prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, where))
    assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), where)


def verify(obj, rows, own):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        ok = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        if DISCOVER and not ok:
            print('NOT EXACT', hex(address), name)
            continue
        assert ok, (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
                assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own row (??_G)'
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in DATA:
                assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'data'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?flag@') \
                    or symbol.startswith('?foo@') or symbol.startswith('?n@') or symbol.startswith('?root@') \
                    or symbol.startswith('?value@?1??ptr@Context@Security') or symbol.startswith('?type@?1???$singleton@'):
                how = 'local static'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append('%s in %s -> %s (%s)' % (symbol, name, hex(value), names.get(value, '')))
                continue
            bind(symbol, value, name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        result.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'exact': True,
                       'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return result

def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):

            symbol = symbols[index][0]

                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            _, sym_value, sym_section, _ = symbols[index]
            if kind == 6 and sym_section == section + 1 and symbol.startswith('$LN'):
                assert value == address + sym_value - start, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(address + sym_value - start))
                local.add('%s: switch target +%#x verified' % (symbol, sym_value - start))
                continue
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('__TI') or symbol.startswith('__CT') or symbol.startswith('__CTA'):
                how = check_throw_info(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, symbol, value)
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in FOLDED:
                assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'folded'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            elif symbol in UNPROVEN:
                assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'call target of a non-exact row'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_B') or symbol.startswith('?minSize@'):
                how = check_static(raw, sections, definitions, symbol, value, name, address)
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)

def check_throw_info(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, symbol, value):
    """Throw information: the original structure must name the same type descriptors (by RTTI name)."""
    pos, at = definitions[symbol]
    sec = sections[at]
    # Compare the relocations of the compiled structure with the original words at the same offsets.
    data_start = sec[4] + pos
    checked = []
    for i in range(sec[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, sec[5] + 10 * i)
        if not pos <= offset < pos + 0x20:
            continue
        inner = symbols[index][0]
        word = d(value + offset - pos)
        hit = original.imported(word)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(inner), (symbol, inner, hex(word), hit)
            checked.append('%s=%s!%s' % (inner, hit[0], hit[1]))
        elif inner.startswith('??_R0'):
            assert original.string(word + 8) == '.' + inner[5:-2], (symbol, inner, hex(word))
            checked.append('%s=RTTI' % inner)
        elif inner in own_all:
            assert own_all[inner] == word, (symbol, inner, hex(word))
            checked.append('%s=own' % inner)
        elif inner.startswith('__C') or inner.startswith('__TI'):
            checked.append('%s=%s' % (inner, check_throw_info(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, inner, word)))
        elif inner in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[inner] == word, (symbol, inner, hex(word))
            checked.append('%s=external' % inner)
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # inside %s" % (inner, word, symbol))
    return 'throw info [%s]' % ', '.join(checked)


def check_static(raw, sections, definitions, symbol, value, name, address):
    """Function-local static / its guard word: bound to the address the original row uses (unit-local)."""
    statics.setdefault((symbol, address), value)
    return 'unit-local static of %08x' % address

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw_ = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw_)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw_, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address):
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            expect, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]], 'bound (??_G)'
        elif slot == '__purecall':
            hit = original.imported(value)
            expect, how = (value if hit is not None and hit[1] == '_purecall' else None), 'import _purecall'
            if expect is None and value == 0x6a16be:
                expect, how = value, '_purecall (static CRT, 006a16be)'
        elif slot in slot_names:
            expect, how = slot_names[slot], 'bound'
        else:
            hits = [v for k, v in SLOT_EXTERNAL.items() if slot.startswith(k)]
            expect, how = (hits[0] if len(hits) == 1 else None), 'slot body not built here'
        ok = expect == value
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value), hex(expect) if expect is not None else None))
    assert not bad, (symbol, bad)
    return out

def alloc_before(function, size, callee):
    b = body(function)
    at = b.index(b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size)) if size > 0x7f else b.index(b'\x6a' + bytes([size]))
    call = b.index(b'\xe8', at)
    while (function + call + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', b, call + 1)[0]) & 0xffffffff != callee:
        call = b.index(b'\xe8', call + 1)
    return at

def target_of(address):
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return body, refs


def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', '%08x' % address, key[:120], [h[0][:120] for h in hits])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def verify(obj, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            _, sym_value, sym_section, _ = symbols[index]
            if kind == 6 and sym_section == section + 1 and symbol.startswith('$LN'):
                # switch-table entry inside the row: the original entry must name the same offset in the function
                assert value == address + sym_value - start, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(address + sym_value - start))
                local.add('%s: switch target +%#x verified' % (symbol, sym_value - start))
                continue
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in FOLDED:
                assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'folded'
            elif symbol in DATA:
                assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'data'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            elif symbol in UNPROVEN:
                assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'call target of a non-exact row'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address):
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            expect, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]], 'bound (??_G)'
        elif slot == '__purecall':
            hit = original.imported(value)
            expect, how = (value if hit is not None and hit[1] == '_purecall' else None), 'import _purecall'
        else:
            expect, how = slot_names.get(slot), 'bound'
        ok = expect == value
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value)))
    assert not bad, (symbol, bad)
    return out

def alloc_before(function, size, callee):
    body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % function)
    at = body.index(b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size)) if size > 0x7f else body.index(b'\x6a' + bytes([size]))
    call = body.index(b'\xe8', at)
    while (function + call + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', body, call + 1)[0]) & 0xffffffff != callee:
        call = body.index(b'\xe8', call + 1)
    return at

    (0x4b96a0, '??1' + NFP + 'UAE@XZ', 'bases'),
    (0x4b9bb0, '??_G' + NFP + 'UAEPAXI@Z', 'bases'),
    (0x4b9ad0, '??0' + DNC + 'IAE@XZ', 'bases'),
    (0x4b9bb0, '??_G' + DNC + 'UAEPAXI@Z', 'bases'),

    0x7f2290: ('??__Fevent_Received@Network@RBX@@YAXXZ', 'marker'),
    0x4b3800: ('??__Ffoo@?1??classDescriptor@' + DESC_R, 'bases'),

def resolve(rows):
    out = []
    for address, key, unit in rows:
        funcs = match.coff_functions(OBJECTS[unit].read_bytes())
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key)
                                                       and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        assert len(hits) == 1, (hex(address), key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0], unit))
    return out


def bind(symbol, value, where):
    prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, where))
    assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), where)


def literal_of(raw, sections, definitions, symbol):
    pos, at = definitions[symbol]
    return raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'


def verify(rows, own):
    result = []
    for address, name, unit in rows:
        raw = OBJECTS[unit].read_bytes()
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
        bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        ok = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        if DISCOVER and not ok:
            print('NOT EXACT', hex(address), name)
            continue
        assert ok, (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol) or EXTERNAL.get(symbol) == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                literal = literal_of(raw, sections, definitions, symbol)
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol in ('?sReplicator@Network@RBX@@3QBDB', '?sMarker@Network@RBX@@3QBDB'):
                literal = literal_of(raw, sections, definitions, symbol)
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'class-name array %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
                assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own row (??_G)'
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in DATA:
                assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'data'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or symbol.startswith('?foo@') \
                    or symbol.startswith('?n@') or symbol.startswith('?flag@'):
                how = 'local static'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append('%s in %s -> %s (%s)' % (symbol, name, hex(value), names.get(value, '')))
                continue
            bind(symbol, value, name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        result.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'exact': True,
                       'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return result


atexit_rows = []

    atexit_rows.append((struct.unpack_from('<I', body, push + 1)[0], key, unit))

for address, name, unit in rows:

assert not UNBOUND, '\n'.join(UNBOUND)

# ---- vtables (current-header objects), RTTI, allocation sizes and strings ----------------------------
d = lambda a: struct.unpack('<I', original.data(a, 4))[0]


def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, index = definitions[symbol]
    section = sections[index]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(section[7]):
        offset, sym, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, section[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start and kind == 6:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[sym][0]
    return slots

STORES = {
    0x4b94a0: ('.?AVIdSerializer@Network@RBX@@', [0x82534c, 0x82533c, 0x825334, 0x82532c, 0x82531c, 0x82530c,
                                                  0x8252fc, 0x8252ec, 0x8252dc, 0x8252cc]),
    0x4b9570: ('.?AV' + NFP, [0x82540c, 0x825400, 0x8253f8, 0x8253f0, 0x8253e0, 0x8253d0, 0x8253c0, 0x8253b0,
                              0x8253a0, 0x825390]),
    0x4b9ad0: ('.?AV' + DNC, [0x8255d4, 0x8255c8, 0x8255c0, 0x8255b8, 0x8255a8, 0x825598, 0x825588, 0x825578,
                              0x825568, 0x825558]),
    0x4b85b0: ('.?AV' + MFP, [0x8251e8]),
    0x4b9140: ('.?AVMarker@Network@RBX@@', [0x82529c]),

    body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % ctor)
    for vt in vts:
        assert struct.pack('<I', vt) in body, (hex(ctor), hex(vt))
        assert original.vtable_class(vt)[0] == rtti, (hex(vt), original.vtable_class(vt), rtti)
        assert vt in bound_vts, ('vtable store not bound', hex(ctor), hex(vt))

text = next(x for x in original.pe.sections if x.Name.startswith(b'.text'))
TEXT = (original.image + text.VirtualAddress, original.image + text.VirtualAddress + text.Misc_VirtualSize)


def original_slots(vt):
    n = 0
    while TEXT[0] <= d(vt + 4 * n) < TEXT[1]:
        n += 1
    return n


# Vtables of the classes recovered here (every vtable their constructors store) are slot-checked against the
# original: same slot count and every slot bound. Other vtables the rows reference (Instance bases, the Marker
# signal descriptor) are verified by RTTI only. Known slot-count difference, recorded rather than hidden:
# util/Object.h declares NonFactoryProduct::getClassName `virtual`, which adds a slot 1 to Marker and
# NonFactoryProduct<DescribedBase, sMarker> (DescribedBase has no getClassName); the 2008 vtables 0082529c and
# 008251e8 have one slot. PROPOSAL below; the pending build confirms it.
KNOWN_EXTRA_SLOT = {0x82529c: 1, 0x8251e8: 1}

    obj = next(OBJECTS[u] for u in OBJECTS if symbol in match._coff_data_index(OBJECTS[u].read_bytes())[2])
    slots = vtable_slots(obj, symbol)
    count = original_slots(vt)
    assert len(slots) == count + KNOWN_EXTRA_SLOT.get(vt, 0), (hex(vt), symbol, len(slots), count)
    entries = {}
    for slot, name in sorted(slots.items()):
        if slot >= count:
            entries[slot] = '%s -> (no slot in the 2008 vtable; util/Object.h proposal)' % name
            continue

        if name.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + name[4:]) in own:
            assert own['??_G' + name[4:]] == value, (symbol, slot, name, hex(value))
            how = 'own row (??_G)'
        elif name in own:
            assert own[name] == value, (symbol, slot, name, hex(value), hex(own[name]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif name in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[name] == value, (symbol, slot, name, hex(value))
            how = 'external'
        else:
            how = 'evidence name' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(name) else 'bound (consistent across rows/slots)'
        bind(name, value, symbol)
        entries[slot] = '%s -> %s (%s)' % (name, hex(value), how)
    vtables.append({'vtable': hex(vt), 'symbol': symbol, 'rtti_offset': original.vtable_class(vt)[1],

def target_of(address):
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return body, refs


def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', '%08x' % address, key[:120], [h[0][:120] for h in hits])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def verify(obj, rows, own, strict=True, record=True, unit=None):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            _, sym_value, sym_section, _ = symbols[index]
            if kind == 6 and sym_section == section + 1 and symbol.startswith('$LN'):
                # switch-table entry inside the row: the original entry must name the same offset in the function
                assert value == address + sym_value - start, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(address + sym_value - start))
                local.add('%s: switch target +%#x verified' % (symbol, sym_value - start))
                continue
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif (unit, symbol) in UNIT_DATA:
                assert UNIT_DATA[(unit, symbol)] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                compiled = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + pos + 4]
                assert original.data(value, 4) == compiled, (name, symbol, hex(value), compiled.hex())
                how = 'unit-local constant %s (bytes)' % compiled.hex()
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in FOLDED:
                assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'folded'
            elif symbol in DATA:
                assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'data'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            elif symbol in UNPROVEN:
                assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'call target of a non-exact row'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault((unit, symbol) if (unit, symbol) in UNIT_DATA else symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address):
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            expect, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]], 'bound (??_G)'
        elif slot == '__purecall':
            hit = original.imported(value)
            expect, how = (value if hit is not None and hit[1] == '_purecall' else None), 'import _purecall'
        else:
            expect, how = slot_names.get(slot), 'bound'
        ok = expect == value
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value)))
    assert not bad, (symbol, bad)
    return out

# Allocation sizes: the factories push 0x8c before the surface constructors; SphereMesh pushes 0x28 before Level().


def alloc_before(function, size, callee):
    body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % function)
    at = body.index(b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size)) if size > 0x7f else body.index(b'\x6a' + bytes([size]))
    call = body.index(b'\xe8', at)
    while (function + call + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', body, call + 1)[0]) & 0xffffffff != callee:
        call = body.index(b'\xe8', call + 1)
    return at

def resolve(obj, rows):

def verify(obj, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in DATA:
                assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'descriptor (initializer checked)'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def alloc_before(function, size, callee):
    body = body_of(function)
    at = body.index(b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size)) if size > 0x7f else body.index(b'\x6a' + bytes([size]))
    call = body.index(b'\xe8', at)
    while (function + call + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', body, call + 1)[0]) & 0xffffffff != callee:
        call = body.index(b'\xe8', call + 1)
    return at
